tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background on every page. Ink and ink-muted sit on it.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Alternate section bands, code blocks, the article header band. Ink, ink-muted and link all pass 4.5:1 on it in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and table rules. Decorative only, never a control edge.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, dates, reading time and excerpts on surface-100 and surface-200. Passes 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative card edges and section dividers on surface-100. Not for form controls or focus; use border-strong there.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and button outlines, and any border that carries meaning. Reaches 3:1 on surface-100 and surface-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand blue for illustration, large graphics, chart series and the cover. Not for text: 3.8:1 on light surface-100. Text and fills use action.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds and illustration fills only. Never text or control edges (2.1:1 on light surface-100).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Decorative highlights, text selection tint and the cover. Not a focus ring (2.7:1 on light surface-100).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Filled buttons and the one primary CTA per view. Carries on-action text: 6.0:1 in light, 4.7:1 in dark.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Button label text on action fills.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline text links, the active navigation item and text-style CTAs on surface-100 and surface-200. 5.4:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px with 2px offset, on every surface. Solid, 5:1 or more in both themes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Homepage hero headline. Desktop and tablet only; use display-lg below 768px.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section headings on the homepage and the blog archive title.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Section headings in sans, and the article h2 on mobile.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Project titles, article card titles, timeline roles, the text wordmark.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Hero supporting paragraph and section leads.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code on surface-200.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Numbered project labels, category tags and metadata dates. Uppercase only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap and tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; link underline offset.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between tags and metadata items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between list items and mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card inner padding; horizontal padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a section heading and its content; horizontal padding from 768px.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap inside a project showcase between media and text.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Vertical padding between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical padding between major homepage sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code and tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and the theme toggle.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Project media frames only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Single status markers only. Not for buttons or tags.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Hover lift on a project preview and the floating header after scroll. Use once per view.

tokens.name: container-wide
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the homepage, projects and blog archive.

tokens.name: container-prose
tokens.usage: Maximum width of article body text; 65 to 75 characters per line.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Compact header height on desktop.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Colour and underline transitions on hover and focus.

tokens.name: motion-normal
tokens.usage: Button and navigation state changes.

tokens.name: motion-slow
tokens.usage: One scroll reveal per section. Never above 600ms.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default easing for every transition and reveal.
